artifact: Issue #9 M4-1 write operation descriptor contract

authority_boundary.meaning: The descriptor declares requirements and compatibility semantics. Trusted authorization and semantic decisions are supplied and checked by later stages.

base_model.rule: Do not create a second read/write registry or put a runtime callable in descriptor semantics.

required_descriptor_semantics.declared_semantic_inputs: named, typed, bounded model-facing inputs; trusted metadata is a separate namespace
required_descriptor_semantics.required_context: trusted/mechanical context keys that must be resolved before execution
required_descriptor_semantics.optional_context: trusted/mechanical context keys that may be absent
required_descriptor_semantics.mutation_scope: platform-neutral semantic scope, required for mutation operations
required_descriptor_semantics.required_authority_class: declared authority class/evidence requirement; not a grant
required_descriptor_semantics.materialized_decision_requirement: whether an exact Materialized Decision is required
required_descriptor_semantics.valid_predecessor_semantics: allowed lifecycle predecessor state(s) and no-effect invalid-state behavior
required_descriptor_semantics.valid_successor_semantics: mechanically produced successor state and effect classification
required_descriptor_semantics.subject_revision_precondition_requiremen: whether exact Subject CAS is required
required_descriptor_semantics.external_authority_precondition_requirem: whether raw source revision/digest is required
required_descriptor_semantics.result_contract: reference to canonical mutation result envelope and effect states
required_descriptor_semantics.machine_readable_errors: closed or explicitly versioned canonical error codes

internal_ids_required.rule: declared for trusted mechanical binding only; never model-facing normal input

contract_hash.canonicalization: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted object keys, deterministic input ordering, compact separators and no runtime registry state
excludes: principal instance or runtime authorization values

EXAMPLE_A.valid_successor: completion recorded and Subject revision advances
EXAMPLE_A.idempotency: same intent replay; different intent conflict

platform_neutrality.adapter_private_materialization: Platform identifiers and API payloads may exist only inside a concrete adapter and may not alter Core descriptor semantics unless represented by a platform-neutral semantic target.
